about_the_game:
Do you have what it takes to reach the Ark? 🐧💨

Run, jump, slide, shoot, and do whatever it takes to stay ahead.
In a world about to be swallowed by the sea, you’ll race through chaotic tracks against other penguins, all competing for the one and only spot on the mysterious Ark.

Face dangerous routes, unpredictable obstacles, tricky power-ups, and well-hidden shortcuts that reward sharp eyes and bold decisions.
Speed is only part of the victory. The rest depends on strategy, timing, and clever moves.


This is a playable preview🎮

This is a limited and experimental version, created to showcase the core gameplay and open space for early feedback from the community.
Any thoughts or suggestions are truly welcome. Your input is a valuable part of the game's future.

Everything you see here ( programming, art, sound, and design ) was created by a single developer over the course of a full year of dedicated work.
This is a personal indie project, and this demo is its first step into the world.

short_description: News of the Great Flood has reached the South Pole, and rumor has it there's an Ark ready to help... but only one spot per species! Jump, slide, and sabotage your rivals as you race against time to secure your place. It's every penguin for itself and the world against them all!
